title: Ivanov's finite-index Frattini conjecture for subgroups of mapping class groups
summary: Let $S_g$ be a closed oriented surface of genus $g$. Ivanov conjectured that if $G$ a finitely generated subgroup of $\mathrm{Mod}(S_g)$ its finite-index Frattini subgroup $Φ_f(G)$ is nilpotent. We prove this conjecture, using recent partial results of the first author about the Andersen-Masbaum-Ueno conjecture.
